text:
olivia: Flagging a customer issue: DataCorp saw ~8 service accounts deprovisioned after our key rotation last night. They say SCIM webhooks returned 200s but users disappeared.

sam: Did we run the rewrap preflight?

tanvi: We started the rewrap job but it hit KMS throttling; logs show partial completion.

security-oncall: What error is the provisioner logging?

tanvi: Short sample: `kms.Decrypt InvalidCiphertextException: key arn not found` — seems some ext_id blobs use old envelope format.

olivia: Outcome: provisioner can't decrypt -> treats identity as unknown -> issues deprov.

sam: Immediate mitigation: pause auto-deprov for affected tenants. I'll flip flag.

ops-bot: [config] PATCH /flags/scim.auto_deprovision=false -> 200

tanvi: I'll re-run rewrap with smaller batches and exponential backoff against KMS. Route through rate-limiter. ETA 45m.

security-oncall: Add a "decrypt-failed" audit event so we keep chain-of-custody. Also open CLOUDF ticket to confirm KMS alias propagation behavior.

olivia: Add design question to vuln triage: per-tenant CMKs vs multi-tenant alias tradeoff.

sam: Rewrap started. Streaming brief updates.

ops-bot: [job] rewrap-rb-20260322 started by sam.

security-oncall: After rewrap and audit backfill, coordinate with account team before re-enabling auto-deprov.

tanvi: Pass 1: 70% complete. Few 429s retried.

olivia: Good. Keep logs tight for compliance.

sam: Pass 2 complete. Full rewrap done. Generating audit backfill now.

ops-bot: [alert] DataCorp reports recovery of scheduled jobs. Ticket DAT-442 updated.

security-oncall: Schedule blameless postmortem and update runbook: preflight rewrap completeness -> flip alias -> enable auto-deprov.

olivia: Closing unless new signals appear. Thanks all.
